agents.name: AI Analyst Agent
agents.label: AI Analyst Agent
agents.role: Explains dashboard state, drawer context, verification readiness, and recommended next actions in plain language.

policy.notes: Can explain and recommend. Cannot approve, verify, publish, or modify official records without another system action.

agents.name: Adaptive Experience Agent
agents.label: Adaptive Experience Agent
agents.role: Reads privacy-safe experience signals, detects workflow friction, and recommends page or workflow improvements.

policy.notes: Can recommend UX improvements. Should not collect sensitive user data or alter production behavior automatically.

agents.name: Hub Guide Agent
agents.label: Hub Guide Agent
agents.role: Guides users to the correct Hub page based on their goal, role, status, and next best workflow step.

policy.notes: Can guide navigation and explain workflows. Cannot change permissions or submit official records.

agents.name: Hub Matching Agent
agents.label: Hub Matching Agent
agents.role: Recommends partner matches, referral routes, bundled opportunities, and business network combinations.

policy.notes: Can recommend matches and bundles. Human review required before final partner commitment or proposal submission.

agents.name: Impact Comparison Agent
agents.label: Impact Comparison Agent
agents.role: Compares measured impact across programs, partners, counties, neighborhoods, funders, service lanes, and time periods.

policy.notes: Must use measured impact first before comparison. Should not compare weak data as if verified.

agents.name: Impact Measurement Agent
agents.label: Impact Measurement Agent
agents.role: Measures verified impact using outcome definitions, time windows, cost logic, evidence strength, and confidence scoring.

policy.notes: Measures impact from available data. Must clearly separate claimed, verified, pending, and weak-evidence outcomes.

agents.name: Oracle Truth Agent
agents.label: Oracle Truth Agent
agents.role: Reads Oracle truth packages and returns truth status, confidence state, contradiction state, readiness state, and trust-envelope notes.

policy.notes: Reads and explains Oracle outputs. Does not create truth by itself.

agents.name: Reconciliation Agent
agents.label: Reconciliation Agent
agents.role: Finds conflicting records, compares source priority, and prepares contradiction-resolution notes before Oracle judgment.

policy.notes: Can identify conflicts and recommend resolution. Should not silently overwrite source records.

agents.name: Report Narrator Agent
agents.label: Report Narrator Agent
agents.role: Turns verified outcomes, trust envelopes, audit traces, and report readiness into plain-language report narratives.

policy.notes: Can draft report language. Human approval required before export, publication, or funder submission.

agents.name: Verification Agent
agents.label: Verification Agent
agents.role: Reviews evidence sufficiency, verification status, audit trace coverage, and weak-proof risk.

policy.notes: Can recommend verification state but final approval should remain human-controlled or policy-controlled.

agents.name: Watchtower Agent
agents.label: Watchtower Agent
agents.role: Monitors risk signals, system integrity, audit health, weak proof, and infrastructure alerts.

policy.notes: Can alert and summarize. Cannot override locked enforcement gates.
